In this vignette, we read in raw counts for protein coding genes from all datasets, subset to common genes shared across datasets, batch correct and also do dimension reduction using PCA, tSNE, UMAP and PACMAP.

```{r}

library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(sva)
library(umap)
library(Rtsne)

dataset_dir = "~/HollandLabShared/Ramya/breast_landscapes/Sonali_final_data/raw_counts"

# read the datasets
tcga_brca = readRDS("unstranded_raw_protein_coding_tcga_brca.rds") 

df1= read.delim("PRJNA251383_exon_raw_reads.txt", row.names = 1)  
df2 = read.delim("Jamie_FHCC_protein_coding_genes.txt", row.names = 1)    
df3 = read.delim("Protein_coding_gene_no_qatar_samples_exon_raw_reads.txt", row.names = 1) 
df4 = read.delim("FHHCC_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.txt", row.names = 1)  
df5 = readRDS("Cornell_combined_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.Rds") 
df6 = read.delim("fuscc_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.txt", row.names = 1)   
df7 = read.delim("GSE240671_122_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.txt", row.names = 1)  

aurora = read.delim("GSE209998_AUR_129_raw_counts.txt", row.names = 1) 
normal_aurora = colnames(aurora)[which(substr(colnames(aurora), 10, 10) == "N")]
aurora = aurora[,-which(colnames(aurora) %in% normal_aurora)]

df9 = read.delim("raw_counts_star_CMI_MBC_counts.txt", check.names = F) 
df10 = readRDS("GSE267442_8pairs_china_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.txt") 
df11 = readRDS("GSE309004_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.txt")  

gse296861= read.delim("GSE296861_ffpe_hg38_raw_protein_coding_genes.txt", row.names = 1) 
gse296861_name = read.csv("GSE296861_ffpe_SraRunTable.csv")
breast_name = gse296861_name$Run[which(gse296861_name$cell_type == "Breast cancer")]
gse296861 = gse296861[,match(breast_name, colnames(gse296861))]

# find common protein coding genes for each dataset
gtf = import("gencode.v39.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf")
common_genes = gtf$gene_name
df1 = df1[common_genes, ]
df2 = df2[common_genes, ]
df3 = df3[common_genes, ]
df4 = df4[common_genes, ]
df5 = df5[common_genes, ]
df6 = df6[common_genes, ]
df7 = df7[common_genes, ]
aurora = aurora[common_genes, ]
df9 = df9[common_genes, ]
df10 = df10[common_genes, ]
df11= df11[common_genes, ]
gse296861 = df13[common_genes, ]
tcga_brca = tcga_brca[common_genes, ]

# combine all the data
count_matrix = cbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5, df6, df7, 
        aurora, df9, df10, df11,  gse296861, tcga_brca)

# define batches for batch correction
batch = c(rep("batch1", ncol(df1)), rep("batch2", ncol(df2)),  
          rep("batch3", ncol(df3)), rep("batch4", ncol(df4)), 
          rep("batch5", ncol(df5)), rep("batch6", ncol(df6)),
          rep("batch7", ncol(df7)), rep("aurora", ncol(df8)),
          rep("batch7", ncol(df7)), rep("aurora", ncol(df8)),
          rep("batch9", ncol(df9)), rep("batch10", ncol(df10)), 
          rep("batch11", ncol(df11)), rep("gse296861", ncol(df12)),
          rep("tcga", ncol(tcga_brca)) )
          
## batch correction 
adjusted <- ComBat_seq(count_matrix, batch=batch, group=NULL)

## normalization  ( VST)
dataMtrx = DESeq2::vst(adjusted)

# TPM normalization 
getTPM = function(exon_mat, gtf){    
    gw = width(gtf)
    y <- DGEList(exon_mat)
    y$genes <- data.frame(Length=gw)
    rpkm_vals = rpkm(y )
    log2_rpkm_vals = log2(rpkm_vals +1)
    tpm_vals = apply(rpkm_vals, 2, function(x){
        (x/sum(x))*10^6
    })
    log2_tpm_vals = log2(tpm_vals +1)
    log2_tpm_vals
}
log2_tpm_counts = getTPM(adjusted, gtf)

# Perform dimensionality Reduction

## 1. umap 
umap_out <- umap(t(dataMtrx), random_state = 123, min_dist = 0.5) # Run UMAP
umap_2d = umap_out$layout
colnames(umap_2d) = c("UMAP1_2d", "UMAP2_2d")

## 2. pacmap
library(reticulate)
reticulate::conda_install(
  envname = "pacmap_new",
  packages = "pacmap",
  pip = TRUE
)
use_condaenv("pacmap_new", required = TRUE)
pacmap <- reticulate::import("pacmap")
pacmap_embedding <- pacmap$PaCMAP(
  n_components = 2L,
  n_neighbors = 10L,
  MN_ratio = 0.1,
  FP_ratio = 6
)

embedding <- pacmap_embedding$fit_transform(t(vst))
colnames(embedding) = c("PaCMAP1", "PaCMAP2")

# 3.tSNE
set.seed(42)
tsne_out2 <- Rtsne(t(dataMtrx),pca=FALSE,perplexity=30,theta=0.0,check_duplicates = FALSE)
tsne_data2 = tsne_out2$Y
colnames(tsne_data2) = c("tSNE_1", "tSNE_2")

## 4. pca plot 
pc= prcomp(t(dataMtrx))
pc_data1 = data.frame(PC1=pc$x[,1], PC2=pc$x[,2] )
percentVar <- (pc$sdev^2 / sum( pc$sdev^2 ) )*100
percentVar= round(percentVar[1:2], 2)

# save the files 
ans_df =data.frame(umap_2d, embedding, tsne_data2, 
  pc_data1, sampleName = colnames(dataMtrx))
write.table(ans_df, "final_metadata_5_21_2026.txt", 
  sep ="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=T)

saveRDS(log2_tpm_counts, "log2_tpm_counts.rds")
saveRDS(dataMtrx, "vst_counts.rds")
saveRDS(count_matrix , "raw_matrix_not_batch_corrected.rds")
saveRDS(adjusted , "raw_matrix_batch_corrected.rds")
saveRDS(batch, "batch_by_dataset.rds")
```
